channel.title: Origin of Speech
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Origin of Speech

item.title: तिङ्
item.description: तिङ् प्रत्यय are instruction set referring to action required to dock and launch boats. the action required depends on three parameters.

item.title: बहु
item.description: बहु = ब ह उ contain hard outward constraint tight outward verb(tight) constraint.

item.title: द्वि
item.description: द्वि = द व इ give wave inward give wave objectify roll wave inward roll wave objectify द्वि as objectified rolling waves (tide) refers to depth at this time.

item.title: एक
item.description: एक = ए क receive hand/limb connect hand/limb इ + कन = below/inward + hand held pull with interchangeability of क प below/inward + move below/pull.

item.title: वचन
item.description: वचन = व च न wave repeat pull wave repeat count.

item.title: उत्तम
item.description: उत्तम = उ त त म up float float inside (water) Refering to anchorage this means deep sea anchor.

item.title: मध्यम
item.description: मध्यम = म ध य म inside carry join fish as मध्यम पुरुष - anchorage where inside (of water)-pier (carry+join) - inside (of water) set up exists.

item.title: प्रथम
item.description: प्रथम = प्र थ म Leg+water high ground inside grab (with what we now call leg) high ground inside.

item.title: पुरुष
item.description: पुरुष = प उ र उ ष or प उ ऋ ष verb(rope) water outward pointed verb(rope) superior pointed Anchor.

item.title: आत्मनै
item.description: आत्मनै = अ अ त म न ऐ up to float inside of pull (inward tide).
